user_query: I want to surprise my friends with a unique trivia night. Can you provide me with some quiz questions from the Soft-cat-quiz API? Additionally, it would be great if you could fetch some random riddles of different difficulty levels from the Riddlie API to challenge the participants. Lastly, I'm interested in some interesting records related to push ups from the Guinness-World-Records-Api to share during the event.

TaskList.description: Fetch quiz questions from the Soft-cat-quiz API to prepare trivia questions for the event.
Retrieve random riddles of varying difficulty levels from the Riddlie API to challenge participants.
Get interesting push-up records from the Guinness-World-Records-Api to share during the event.
